captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a classroom monocular microscope with a light-grey rectangular base and a matching curved vertical arm. It features a black rectangular specimen stage equipped with a sliding black stage carriage, a rotating light-grey objective turret, and a small black diaphragm lever underneath. The optical head assembly is mounted on a vertical guide track, allowing realistic prismatic sliding adjustments.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a classroom monocular microscope with a rectangular base, curved arm support, black specimen stage, and an adjustable optical head. Ensure the head carriage slides vertically, the objective turret rotates, the stage carriage slides horizontally across the stage, and the small diaphragm lever pivot beneath the stage rotates.
captions.factory: Construct the base and curved arm using boolean operations on boxes and cylinders to form the main frame. Create the stage as a flat black box, then add the sliding stage carriage and the rotating objective turret below the monocular eyepiece assembly. Define four distinct joints: a prismatic joint for the vertical movement of the optical head carriage, a continuous rotational joint for the objective turret, a prismatic joint for the stage carriage, and a revolute joint for the diaphragm lever underneath the stage.
